run_random_agents: run the random agents example on the 8m StarCraft map for 10 episodes
create_starcraft_env: create a StarCraft2Env instance with a specified map name like 8m
get_env_info: get environment info including number of actions and agents from StarCraft2Env
step_random_actions: step the environment by selecting random available actions for each agent
review_main: review the main function that runs random agents in the SMAC environment
